name: @o7/ios
description: o7 for iPhone. The app builds with Xcode; these scripts keep its generated Swift sources in step with the desktop's.

scripts.generate: node scripts/write-palettes.mts && node scripts/write-pixel-goldens.mts && node scripts/write-agent-logos.mts && node scripts/write-highlighter.mjs && node scripts/write-icon.mjs && node --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs scripts/write-goldens.mts
scripts.check: node scripts/write-palettes.mts --check && node scripts/write-pixel-goldens.mts --check && node scripts/write-agent-logos.mts --check && node scripts/write-highlighter.mjs --check && node scripts/write-icon.mjs --check && node --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs scripts/write-goldens.mts --check
